to open, maintain, operate and close bank accounts

or conducive to the carrying out of the objects of the
Corporation.
(1) The Fund  of the Corporation shall consist of—
all moneys lying to the credit of the Foundation on

the  day 
immediately  preceding 
the  date  of
commencement  of  this  Act  which  shall  stand
transferred to the Corporation with effect from that
date ; and
all moneys that may accrue to the Corporation after
the date of commencement of this Act.
